headline: Indian markets face historic eight-week losing streak as Nifty tests support amid persistent FII selling

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Persistent FII outflows and aggressive selling of Indian stocks
Geopolitical tensions and concerns regarding the Hormuz disruption
Benchmark indices recording their longest weekly losing run in 25 years
Global market cues from Dow Jones and Nasdaq impacting investor sentiment
whatHappening: Nifty 50 is testing crucial support levels between 22,400 and 22,600
Ola Electric founder Bhavish Aggarwal backs rights issue with personal stake
Indian equity markets have declined for eight consecutive weeks
Recent market sell-offs have resulted in significant investor wealth erosion
summary: Indian markets are under pressure after a historic eight-week losing streak driven by relentless FII selling and geopolitical concerns. Nifty is currently testing support near the 22,400 level as volatility remains high. In corporate developments, Ola Electric's founder is personally backing a rights issue to strengthen the company's position.
